description: Lignes électriques haute et très haute tension (HTB) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Géo2France (Géo2France). This dataset makes it possible to visualise the geographical location of high and very high voltage (HTB) power line sections. Data IGN-BDTopo cut on Hauts-de-France. GEMET - INSPIRE themes, version 1.0: Sources of energy. Region: HIGH-DE-FRANCE. Departments: SUMMARY. Departments: NORD. Departments: AISNE. Departments: OISE. Departments: NOT-DE-CALAIS. Coverage: Géo2France (Géo2France). The portal shows the English title as "High and Very High Voltage (HTB) Power Lines" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Géo2France (Géo2France). Its keywords include nord, hauts-de-france, energie, somme, oise, aisne. The listing shows 1 download or service links in OGC:WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
